source.creator: 梁志坚
source.source_type: Published process text with ordered photographs: hand sketch, font structure reference, outline, draft, adjusted draft, eave-feature integration, final.
source.direct_statement_extracted: Defines classical/melodic overall art direction, selects abstract architectural eaves over wave imagery; places eave-like structural brush on conditional original glyph strokes, staggers position across adjacent characters; must retain recognition and consistent optical weight.
trustworthy_boundaries: Original artwork files are not reproduced, traced or reused
Author-source images support direction and relative treatment, not exact control points
This is source-derived DESIGN HYPOTHESIS; not executable learned author code.

design_target.rationale: Pavilion, below, listening, wind: conceptually coherent; structure contrast 亭（dense enclosure）／下（sparse）／听（left/right）／风（outer enclosure）; unlike source 海棠未雨
design_target.visual_program: Restrained contemporary Chinese eave/quiet-wind type logo, dark ink on transparent canvas, no pictorial roofs, leaves, waves or clouds
design_target.construct_original: Manually author each substantive stroke contour as unique SVG Bezier path, not font paths and not vector tracing. Freeze geometry before review. Only import into Figma after passing independent visual-quality preflight.
motif_distribution: 亭 top roof is main upturned eave, low amplitude
风 upper enclosure echoes same contour at LOWER visual height, not same curve
下 dominant falling stem and 听 right vertical use related taper but NO pasted eave
Each glyph optical weight adjusted for density; no extra decorative flourish strokes.
design_target.wordmark_layout: One horizontal four-character mark, optical glyph widths intentionally uneven but group balanced, no imagery, no extra text

required_glyph_structure.亭: 点、一、口、冖、丁; top cover and hooked stem distinct
required_glyph_structure.下: 一、丨、丶; dominant vertical with a right dot
required_glyph_structure.听: 口+斤, with left口 legible and right斤 slant/cross/stem
required_glyph_structure.风: 外框（几字变形）+内部交叉撇点; clear enclosed contour

controls.A: Neutral unrelated font-rendered four-character text for legibility benchmark only, explicit NON-creative font baseline
controls.B: One hand-authored vector candidate, no hidden random generator attempts
gate_order: manual glyph recognition & word optical audit
only after credible original style advantage vs A: Figma import/readback
reject_if: Any incorrect target character or overlapping structures
The roof feature is pasted at same height on each character
Only generic font outline with decorative swashes
Looks no different from a system font at medium size
Micro size blurs or glyph identities unclear
controls.remediations: One documented structural correctness repair only if needed, not post-hoc style optimization for a pass
controls.professional_aesthetic_claim: NOT ALLOWED without independent human judgement & cross-word repeat
controls.code_environment: Use SVG built from path data and CairoSVG rasterization, no font binaries shared

next: If pre-Figma rejects, stop with published original proof and diagnosis, no Figma busywork.
